table.chapter: XVI. Currency, Banks, Weights and Measures
table.title: [Rates of the Tax on Net Profit of Banks]

columns: Net Profit Compared with Total Capital of the Bank
rows: (1) When the net profit is less than 15% of the total amount of capital of the bank
(2) When the net profit exceeds 15% but is less than 25% of the total amount of capital of the bank
(3) When the net profit exceeds 25% but is less than 35% of the total amount of capital of the bank
(4) When the net profit exceeds 35% of the total amount of capital of the bank

table.context: Article 3 of the new law on the net profit tax on banks sets the graduated tax rates, which depend on the net profit as a share of the bank's capital.
